explanation: W = 1.05 GeV is below the exclusive pion production threshold. For a proton target the minimum hadronic invariant mass is M + m_π ≈ 0.938 + 0.135 ≈ 1.073 GeV (π⁰p) or M + m_π ≈ 0.938 + 0.140 ≈ 1.078 GeV (π⁺n). At 1.05 GeV the reaction is kinematically impossible, so EXCLURAD (pion channel, pion config) cannot be run. No input file is produced.
